scope: exploratory first-call native Zp IC CPU control on one Modal L4 allocation; no qualified timing tier
statement: The producer Modal panel reports first-call median reference/candidate wall ratios 1.81048, 3.52077, 2.42127 and 1.86590 for the four linear-sieve moduli and 2.55897 for the random-exponent control. All 25 timing pairs are rejected by the frozen placement/cgroup gates; several A/A controls also fail. Producer scalar/arithmetic replay covers 5000 answers, but independent signed standing and execution verification remain absent.
